Basic chat completion via the AWS Bedrock provider using the bedrock/ prefix for routing — verifies the prefix is stripped before dispatching and the Converse API response is normalised to the standard OpenAI chat completion shape

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"max_tokens\":16,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"bedrock/anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0\",\"temperature\":0}")
IO.inspect(result)
```
